retained_failures: Final source/package evaluation attempt 001 is excluded after a non-terminating PowerShell Test-Path guard error allowed both outputs to run. A subsequent trace-verifier probe also omitted PYTHONPATH and stopped at import. All six outputs and the exact wrapper failure remain retained; no image was built.

The first source-real-surface wrapper set only RUNBOOK_SENTINEL_PYTHONPATH; the MCP verifier itself stopped at import because PYTHONPATH was absent. No MCP/API/native output or image was created; exact failure receipt retained.

The first parity-summary hash helper used unavailable System.Convert.ToHexString. Reports remained unchanged; the supported SHA256.Create/ComputeHash path proved exact parity and the diagnostic is retained.

The first post-package aggregate regression invocation ran its designed evaluation-and-promotion tail after all validators and tests passed, creating a valid but unselected baseline-0027-attempt-002 and replacing latest.json. The three output files are retained; latest.json was restored exactly to the selected fail-fast final source attempt before the side-effect-free validator sweep.

The first side-effect-free validator wrapper omitted PYTHONPATH and stopped after 21 passes when verify_stale_payload_projection.py could not import runbook_sentinel. The corrected unchanged sweep set the exact source path and passed all 31 validators while latest.json remained selected exactly.

The first two-image build stopped before runtime verification because BuildKit assigned different current creation timestamps, producing image IDs e231ceed and 63f64522. A correction receipt records that the exact base has eleven layers and the candidates add a directory-only WORKDIR layer plus two COPY layers; the original failure outcome remains correct. No runtime, MCP, API, scan, export, or publication followed.

The second two-image build supplied SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 1786556577. Both configs received the exact frozen creation time, but both COPY layer digests and image IDs still differed; no later gate ran. Official BuildKit semantics and exact logs are retained.

Two process-valid type=image rewrite-timestamp probes produced the same local image ID and frozen creation time, but are excluded from release evidence because the unchanged v2 Dockerfile still adds three layers and the exporter settings were not frozen before the probes. Container-runtime-v3 is now locally frozen before implementation; it preserves exactly two payload layers, moves WORKDIR after both COPY directives, and binds the timestamp, exporter, builder compatibility, clean-process, and no-publication checks.

The first v3 two-image run reproduced exact image ID ad9160e8... twice, then stopped before runtime because WORKDIR still emitted a canonical empty third layer and the exact Docker containerd store assigned a local content digest. Official Docker semantics, exact logs, and local-only events are retained. Container-runtime-v4 is frozen before implementation to remove only WORKDIR and verify local digest-to-ID equality without weakening push/export or runtime boundaries.

The first v4 evaluation preflight omitted PYTHONPATH and stopped before either evaluation. A corrected fail-fast run produced selected passing source/package attempt 004; the import failure remains retained.
The first v4 parity summary used nonexistent split_records instead of split_metrics after parity was already established. The reports remained unchanged and the corrected exact result is retained.

The first bounded v4 artifact scan classified the package contract's literal private-key forbidden-pattern definition as credential material. The failed scan remains retained; the corrected receipt classifies only that definition and has zero unresolved hits.

The first genuine v4 image reveal built exact image ID 2d3f89d... twice but stopped before runtime because integer-second --until excluded build B's tag later within the same second. Expanded read-only events prove both local tags and no push. V5 is frozen around nanosecond bounds plus a one-second completion grace before implementation.

The first focused v5 suite retained one test-schema error after a v4 invariant test loaded the compact v5 contract. The corrected suite separates inherited v4 and v5 event-window mutations and passes five of five.

The first side-effect-free v5 wrapper stopped on PowerShell native-stream handling. The direct subprocess run then reported only the expected three-file stale-manifest boundary; 31 other validators and all 53 tests pass with the selected report unchanged.

The first genuine v5 runtime reveal built exact image ID 96655a01... twice and passed the nanosecond event window, then stopped before product execution because the verifier treated Docker's explicit IpcMode private as host sharing. Exact inspect evidence proves private IPC, empty PID/UTS/userns modes, and every other runtime boundary passing. The failure remains retained; v6 is frozen before the narrow namespace-semantic correction.

The first genuine v6 runtime reveal built exact image ID 90b8b4a9... twice and passed local events, image validation, exact private namespaces, hardened runtime, CLI, and evaluation execution, then stopped because docker cp cannot read files from the /state tmpfs. Exact in-container sizes and hashes plus the reproduced copy failure remain retained; v7 is frozen before a bounded verified exec-stream extraction correction.

The first focused v7 suite stopped on an assumed nonexistent temp_path test helper before exercising product code. The corrected suite, full 55-test regression, required-v7 validation, and real extraction probe pass. A post-success probe summary then reused PowerShell's reserved $Host variable; the extracted file identity and container cleanup were independently confirmed.

The first v7 full verifier stopped before image construction because its prerequisite phase predicate still expected implemented_v6. The exact failure remains retained; the corrected predicate requires implemented_v7.

The next v7 run built the exact image twice and passed runtime, CLI, evaluation, extraction, MCP, and API before host trace verification rejected renamed endpoint files. The exact failure remains retained; the correction preserves the endpoint basenames.

The following v7 run passed every product surface and produced a zero-critical/high Docker Scout SARIF result, then a redundant Unicode scanner-version banner could not be decoded by the host locale. The exact failure remains retained; scanner identity now comes only from structured SARIF.

A one-second foreground launcher stopped before creating an evidence directory, receipt, image, container, or verifier process. No product disposition was inferred; the same unused attempt identity then completed under captured background execution.
